description: Interactive Project Category Filtering & Enhanced Collaboration Outreach

userStories.title: Add category filter pill buttons to ProjectsSection
userStories.description: As a portfolio visitor, I want to see filter buttons for project categories (All, Web, Mobile, etc.) so I can narrow down relevant work.
acceptanceCriteria: Dynamically extract unique categories from PORTFOLIO_DATA.projects
Display 'All' plus each category in a responsive pill tab bar above project cards
Active filter has distinct highlight styling matching the design system (#E11D48 / dark:rose)

userStories.title: Filter project grid based on active category selection
userStories.description: As a visitor, clicking a category tab should immediately filter the displayed projects.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a category updates activeCategory state
Grid renders only projects matching selected category (or all projects if 'All' is active)
Empty state message if no projects match

userStories.title: Add instant Copy Email feedback button to FreelancingCard
userStories.description: As a collaborator or recruiter, I want to quickly copy Nehal's email to my clipboard with instant visual feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a 'Copy Email' action button with copy icon alongside 'Get in Touch'
Clicking copies email to clipboard using navigator.clipboard
